def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Modified multivariate version of the equation."""
    a1, a2, a3, b1, b2, c = parameters
    return a1 + a2 * gate_voltage_abs + a3 * drain_voltage_abs + b1 * gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs
